## Problem and behavior

Describe the observed problem, intended behavior, and linked issue.
State the affected inputs and user-visible result.

## Verification

Give the exact commands, results, source identity, and relevant regression evidence.
Identify fault, proof, fuzz, mutation, browser, or deployment checks affected by the change.

## Remaining boundaries

Name hardware, provider, platform, or hosted checks that still lack observed evidence.
Keep private configuration, phone numbers, recordings, credentials, and publisher originals out of the diff and logs.
